quotes.randomization: Randomisation was balanced by centre, with an allocation sequence based on a block size of eight, generated with a computer random number generator.
quotes.deviations: Both participants and study staff (site investigators and trial coordinating centre staff ) were masked to treatment allocation. Tranexamic acid and placebo ampoules were indistinguishable... All analyses were by intention to treat.
quotes.missingData: Primary outcome data were available for 20 127 (99·6%) randomised patients... All the patients, apart from the four in whom consent was withdrawn, were included in the analysis.
quotes.measurement: No emergency unblinding was needed... Outcomes were recorded if they occurred while the patient was still in hospital for up to 28 days after randomisation. ... We sought high specificity in the diagnosis of non-fatal vascular occlusive events and stipulated that occlusive events should be recorded only when there was clear clinical evidence.
quotes.reporting: The trial protocol was peer-reviewed and published on The Lancet website in 2005. ... The statistical analysis plan was sent to all ethics committees and regulatory agencies before unblinding. ... We prespecified that unless there was strong evidence... no such evidence of heterogeneity... We therefore (post hoc) defined the early category as those treated less than or equal to 1 h from injury
